proof: ADR-003 exit gate — EN/JA/ZH/RU on the adopted Media workspace
method: Live, in the running Electron app. The adopted workspace was opened on a real provider stream (phase4-local-proof extension, MP4 played through the sidecar's authenticated /api/v1/proxy, Japanese VTT selected, mining draft cue-backed). The language was then switched with the app's own Settings > Language control — not by calling setUiLang from a console-imported module, which resolves to a second module instance under Vite and proves nothing.
